verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent docs say received mail is scanned and uploaded to the customer's secure cloud storage account, which has unlimited storage. Customers can log in anytime to a dashboard described as a centralized hub for documents, so notices persist beyond the arrival alert. missing for 10: explicit retention-period or archive-duration guarantee, documentation of what happens to stored documents after cancellation, search/retrieval details for older notices, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, received documents stay archived in the account so a notice can be retrieved months later, not just at notification time
